missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Кино' is an indeclinable neuter noun staying in the nominative as the predicate. 'Интересное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, the only marker of case and gender here.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Кино' is indeclinable, so its form never changes even as the object of 'люблю'. 'Старое' carries the neuter accusative agreement.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. After 'нет' the genitive is expected, but 'кино' is indeclinable and keeps its form. 'Хорошего' shows the neuter genitive agreement instead.
Strategic focus: Accusative of destination. After 'в' motion toward the cinema would take the accusative, but 'кино' stays unchanged. 'Вечером' is the instrumental of time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. After 'в' the prepositional is expected, yet 'кино' keeps its single form. 'Много людей' describes the crowd inside.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. After 'о' the prepositional is required, but 'кино' is indeclinable and unchanged. 'Новом' carries the neuter prepositional agreement.
Strategic focus: Instrumental complement. 'Довольны' governs the instrumental, shown by 'этим' since 'кино' cannot inflect. The neuter instrumental demonstrative carries the case.
Strategic focus: Dative complement. 'Современному' marks the dative governed by 'нужны', while 'кино' itself stays fixed. The sentence states what modern cinema needs.
Strategic focus: Genitive after quantity. 'Много' normally takes the genitive plural, but 'кино' is indeclinable and unchanged. 'Снимают' describes the filmmaking activity.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. After 'без' the genitive is expected; 'кино' keeps its invariable form while 'хорошего' shows neuter genitive agreement.
